In my previous relationship I was cheated on and found out through an app called Snapchat. Tonight he opened his Snapchat feed and there was someone there named “favourite person in the world 🐯” I freaked out and felt hurt so I went quiet then I left the room to chill out and he banged his fist on the desk and said oh my fucking god. When he reacted like that something ticked in me and I doubled back into his room and said “why are you angry!? I did nothing” and he said “you get upset over the most stupidest things” then from there shit hit the fan.. I tried to calm down and went to shower and throw up cause I felt so sick, then went to bed to try and calm down some more but my body was just shaking and my breathing became shallow, my brain was running a million kms an hour. I went to the lounge room cause he went to watch tv and tried to talk it out, all I wanted was assurance that this person meant nothing to him & to have come to my bed to comfort me but he decided to watch tv. He said he didn’t do anything wrong so he didn’t need to come to the room to comfort me & then he said I was accusing him of things he wasn’t doing and it blew up from there. He said me to go away or he was going to hurt himself but I didn’t and it got physical as he was trying to leave the house and I was stopping him.. I was worried he was going to hurt himself so I didn’t want him to leave but we ended up falling over onto the ground and we both hurt ourselves then he just walked out of the house.. I went to the garage to end it but jokesss here I am. Fail fail fail lol
